v1.feedback: The parent's click-cycling mechanic is clearly preserved and the gloaming word genuinely drove the palette — the ember-to-dusk-to-night gradient and state naming feel earned, not decorative. The three biomorphic forms (vascular cup, leaf venation, peristaltic tube) are each readable within 2s and occupy the frame well at 80K particles. To refine: push the gloaming influence deeper into the geometry itself — e.g. have the forms visibly dim or dissolve at their extremities as if light is draining from them, rather than keeping the twilight concept mostly in background gradient and color uniforms; also the peristalsis tube reads as the least connected to the other two states — consider a form that bridges vascular and venation more organically so the click-cycle feels like a continuous twilight transformation rather than three separate specimens.

v2.feedback: The gloaming concept lands well — twilight gradient background, flower-closing-at-dusk narrative across three states, and the warm-amber-to-indigo palette all reinforce the word without being literal. The parent's click-cycle mechanic is preserved and recontextualized. To refine: the vascular cup (state 0) and closing bud (state 2) share too much generative logic, making the crossfade feel like a parameter shift rather than a true morphological event — give the bud distinct vein topology so the fold reads as structural change. The venation state (state 1) is the strongest form but lies flat; a subtle curl along the midrib would tie it to the closing motion and sell the dusk-wilting idea harder.
